Hello!

So, I made some improvements from my last design. I'm still learning CSS, so please let me know if there's a better way to do certain things — I love learning and feedback! Anyway, here are the changes:

  • The theme color is changed to blue to be easier on the eyes and fit better with the default theme here on WhoaVerse.
  • Shadows are de-blurred to fit with the simplistic design.
  • Buttons are now matching the theme!
  • The navigation menu (Hot, New, etc.) is improved to be semi-transparent unless either selected or hovered over.

I'm using this theme on both my subverses, /v/Journal and /v/Nurdoidz. The theme is inspired by the popular Naut theme on Reddit, but I made it from scratch with my limited CSS knowledge and put my own elements in it so it's not seen as a complete rip-off.

Obviously, my theme isn't better, but I'm still learning. Maybe one day I'll be as good!

The CSS code for the theme is located here on PasteBin so you can incorporate it or remix it into your own subverses.
